en_US: Let me size you up...
Aim for the Pokémon League!
That’s all you should be thinking about.
Let me size you up...
You’ll meet many, many Pokémon.
That’s what you should be thinking.
Eventually, the world will appear bigger
to you!
Of course it’s you.
So you made it this far.
I expected nothing less.
Lake Valor. Pal Park. Every time I
looked up, you were standing there.
I used to think strength was simply
something a Trainer had, or didn’t.
It isn’t. It’s something a team is
given, by whoever raises them.
I learned that watching you.
Don’t make me regret admitting it.
Now show me what you’ve built.
Hold back and I won’t forgive it.
...Enough. Rest, all of you.
You gave me everything I asked for.
The failing there was mine.
Not theirs. That’s the truth of it.
And you saw the gap between us
before I did. That’s worth knowing.
So I’m going back to train. Properly.
There won’t be a second loss.
Go on, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}.
The League is waiting.
Win it. I won’t accept less from
someone who beat me.
Hmm, young trainer!
Have you investigated all of what
Victory Road has to offer?
Seek out a great trainer and
defeat them.
Only then will you be ready for the
true test of the Pokémon League.
Hmm, young trainer... Oh?
You have proven yourself worthy and
conquered all that Victory Road has
to offer... Well done!
Go on through. The League awaits!
The Pokémon League lies just ahead.
Give it everything you have!
